info.title: Lighter WebSocket API
info.description: Real-time market data, account state, and transaction submission for the zkLighter exchange. Hand-mirrored from https://apidocs.lighter.xyz/docs/websocket-reference. The schemas are intentionally permissive (`additionalProperties: true`, all channel-specific fields optional) so server-side additions do not invalidate generated clients.

mainnet.description: Mainnet WebSocket gateway. Append `?readonly=true` to bypass IP region restrictions for read-only data.

order_book.title: Order Book
order_book.description: Order book snapshots and diffs for a given market. Snapshots ship on subscribe; subsequent messages are price-level diffs.

ticker.title: Best Bid and Offer (BBO)
ticker.description: Best bid/offer updates for a given market.

market_stats.title: Market Stats
market_stats.description: Per-market rolling stats (volume, price change, etc.). Pass `all` as the market id to receive every market on one subscription.

market_id.description: Market index, or the literal string `all` to receive stats for every market.

spot_market_stats.title: Spot Market Stats
spot_market_stats.description: Per-spot-market rolling stats. Pass `all` to receive every spot market on one subscription.

market_id.description: Spot market index, or the literal string `all`.

trade.title: Trade
trade.description: Public trade stream for a given market.

candle.title: Candlesticks
candle.description: Candlestick stream for a (market, resolution) pair.

account_all.title: Account All
account_all.description: Combined account stream: orders, positions, trades, funding histories/rates, and pool shares.

account_market.title: Account Market
account_market.description: Per-market view of a specific account (orders, positions, trades restricted to one market).

user_stats.title: Account Stats
user_stats.description: Aggregate stats for an account (collateral, portfolio value, etc.).

account_tx.title: Account Tx
account_tx.description: Transaction history for a specific account.

account_all_orders.title: Account All Orders
account_all_orders.description: All orders across markets for an account.

account_orders.title: Account Orders
account_orders.description: Orders for an account scoped to a single market.

account_all_trades.title: Account All Trades
account_all_trades.description: All trades for an account across markets. Snapshot keys trades by market index; updates may emit a flat list.

account_all_positions.title: Account All Positions
account_all_positions.description: All positions for an account, keyed by market index.

account_all_assets.title: Account All Assets
account_all_assets.description: Per-asset balances for all spot markets for a specific account. `balance` is in coin terms, not USDC.

account_spot_avg_entry_prices.title: Average Entry Prices
account_spot_avg_entry_prices.description: Spot avg-entry-price stream. Each event accounts as a buy/sell at the index price; `last_trade_id` confirms the validity horizon.

pool_data.title: Pool Data
pool_data.description: Live data for a public pool account.

_control.title: Connection control plane
_control.description: Frames not tied to a subscription address: client → server `subscribe`/`unsubscribe`/`ping`/`jsonapi/sendtx`/`jsonapi/sendtxbatch`, and server → client `connected`/`error`/`pong`/`jsonapi/*` responses.

send_tx_batch.summary: Submit up to 15 signed transactions in a single frame.

SubscribeRequest.name: SubscribeRequest
SubscribeRequest.title: Subscribe
SubscribeRequest.summary: Open a subscription on a channel.

channel.description: Channel address. Use `/` as the path separator (e.g. `order_book/0`).

auth.description: Bearer token. Required for the channels listed under `securitySchemes.bearerToken`.

Ping.name: Ping
Ping.title: Application-level ping
Ping.summary: Heartbeat frame. The server replies with a `Pong`. Either WebSocket-level ping frames or this application-level frame satisfy the 2-minute idle requirement.

SendTx.name: SendTx
SendTx.title: Send transaction
SendTx.summary: Submit a single signed transaction over the socket.

tx_info.description: Signed payload produced by SignerClient. Usually a JSON-encoded string.

SendTxBatch.name: SendTxBatch
SendTxBatch.title: Send transaction batch
SendTxBatch.summary: Submit up to 15 signed transactions in one message. `tx_infos` is a JSON-encoded list of JSON-encoded `tx_info` strings (double-encoded).

tx_types.description: JSON-encoded list of integer tx types, e.g. `"[14,14]"`.

tx_infos.description: JSON-encoded list of JSON-encoded tx_info strings.

Transaction.description: Transaction as emitted on the `account_tx` channel.

info.description: JSON object encoded as string; shape depends on tx type.

event_info.description: JSON object encoded as string; shape depends on tx type.

bearerToken.description: Per-channel auth token passed in the `auth` field of the `subscribe` message. Required for channels whose subscribe operation lists this scheme under `security`. See the `apikeys` REST endpoint for token generation.
